title: DR-15d: mimi-mls leaves list frank_aad 0x0020
description: Answers the question deferred to mimid-1wgh.5.6 by DR-15b (mimid-1wgh.4.45). protocol-06 §5.4.1 defines frank_aad (0x0020) as a Safe AAD component; mimi-protocol (which implements franking) depends on mimi-mls, so mimi-mls cannot discover it. Readings: (a) caller-supplied supported-components list threaded through Identity::key_package and leaf rebuilds; (b) mimi-mls hard-codes 0x0020 as a MIMI component every mimid client supports. Chosen: (b), a fixed rule with no new API; true because every mimid client uses mimi-protocol franking. Cost: mimi-mls knows one MIMI constant (document it). The leaf safe_aad list becomes [0x0020, GREASE]; whether 0x0020 also goes in app_components follows DR-8 (mimid-1wgh.4.25) — list it there too since the client implements it.
